 Summary
 Crystal Palace trail Hoffenheim with manager Pierre Sage under pressure - Wharton dismissed 
 Bournemouth come from behind to lead 10-man Sparta Prague after missed penalty - Cherries make eight changes 
 Sunderland host Zagreb later in Europa League - six changes made 
 Brighton visit Getafe also in late Conference League kick off - team news 
 Hearts at Thun in Conference League before Celtic host Besiktas in Europa League
 Close form Send us your views
 Get involved Live Reporting
 Jess Anderson and Emlyn Begley
 Most recent Most popular SUBSTITUTION published at 19:30 GMT 19:30 GMT 
 Crystal Palace 0-1 Hoffenheim 
 Hoffenheim send Jykese Fields on for Wouter Burger as they try to see this one out.
 2 13 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 YELLOW CARD published at 19:29 GMT 19:29 GMT 
 Sparta Prague 1-2 Bournemouth 
 Sparta's Matej Jurasek gets a merited yellow card for catching James Hill in the face with his arm. He was looking at the Bournemouth player before doing it.
 55 4 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'It's going to make the game very open' published at 19:28 GMT 19:28 GMT 
 Crystal Palace 0-1 Hoffenheim 
 Glenn Hoddle 
Former England and Tottenham manager on TNT Sports 
 It's one thing going down to 10 men and holding onto the game if you're 1-0 up but when you're 1-0 down you have got to come up with something offensive. It's going to make the game very open.
 46 6 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 get involved Get Involved published at 19:28 GMT 19:28 GMT 
 Click 'Get Involved' on this page to have your say 
 Feel for Palace here, they have a ref that falls for every dive, misses obvious calls and dishes out cards like it's Christmas.
 Tony 
 Never a red card. Both were simply jumping for the ball, shoulder to shoulder. Hoffenheim player has got him sent off there. Ref very poor.
 James A 
 114 12 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 19:28 GMT 19:28 GMT 
 Sparta Prague 1-2 Bournemouth 
 Sparta sub Santiago Eneme, who has to take a lot of the blame for that goal, shoots over from 25 yards.
 17 2 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'What a goal' published at 19:27 GMT 19:27 GMT 
 Sparta Prague 1-2 Bournemouth 
 Joe Partington 
Former Bournemouth defender on BBC Radio Solent 
 What a goal. Bournemouth doing what they do best and win the ball high. Reverse pass into Evanilson and he has no right to score from that angle.
 He shifts the ball onto his right foot and passes it into the corner. The Bournemouth fans are going wild.
 Image source, Getty Images 
 147 2 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 19:27 GMT 19:27 GMT 
 Sparta Prague 1-2 Bournemouth 
 As things stand Bournemouth are heading onto four wins from four.
 73 2 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 GOAL - Sparta Prague 1-2 Bournemouth published at 19:25 GMT 19:25 GMT 
 Evanilson (81 mins) 
 Lovely finish.
 Ryan Christie wins the ball off Santiago Eneme and plays in Evanilson. 
 The striker takes a touch and under pressure just guides a gorgeous finish into the far bottom corner.
 Image source, Getty Images 
 441 18 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 19:25 GMT 19:25 GMT 
 Crystal Palace 0-1 Hoffenheim 
 Boos around Selhurst Park as they think Andrej Kramaric has handled the ball.
 Looking at the replays it looks like a clear handball. And he is already on a booking.
 Palace fans probably right to be fuming.
 81 20 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'Huge save' published at 19:25 GMT 19:25 GMT 
 Sparta Prague 1-1 Bournemouth 
 Joe Partington 
Former Bournemouth defender on BBC Radio Solent 
 Huge save. It was a really good pass from Tyler Adams. Alvaro Rodriguez just couldn't get enough power on his shot and it's a good save.
 16 8 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 19:25 GMT 19:25 GMT 
 Sparta Prague 1-1 Bournemouth 
 Tyler Adams picks out Alvaro Rodriguez in the box and the Cherries forward is tackled just as he's shooting. 
 Bournemouth keep the pressure on from the following corner and Bafode Diakite's shot is blocked.
 14 5 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 get involved Get Involved published at 19:24 GMT 19:24 GMT 
 Click 'Get Involved' on this page to have your say 
 To Graham (19:13) - Sage is not the problem either; it’s our recruitment policy that saw us replace our two best centre-backs with a pair of terrible Chelsea loanees.
 Alexander 
 90 10 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'That's a bit harsh' published at 19:23 GMT 19:23 GMT 
 Crystal Palace 0-1 Hoffenheim 
 Glenn Hoddle 
Former England and Tottenham manager on TNT Sports 
 That's a bit harsh. Wharton led with the arm, but there's no intent to do the player. He's just jumped. It's a difficult one.
 Image source, Getty Images 
 36 31 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 SUBSTITUTION published at 19:23 GMT 19:23 GMT 
 Sparta Prague 1-1 Bournemouth 
 Sparta bring on Santiago Eneme and Hugo Sochurek for goalscorer Ebrima Singhateh and Josimar Alcocer.
 2 8 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 19:23 GMT 19:23 GMT 
 Crystal Palace 0-1 Hoffenheim 
 Palace have just over 10 minutes to find something in this game but down to 10 men they are on the back foot.
 The home fans are unhappy as Wouter Burger brings down Darío Osorio and they win a free-kick but there's no card shown.
 They clearly feel if Wharton is shown a second yellow for his earlier foul then Burger should be for that one.
 22 13 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 19:21 GMT 19:21 GMT 
 Sparta Prague 1-1 Bournemouth 
 A sustained period of Bournemouth pressure. Corners and whatnot. Into the final 15 minutes.
 62 3 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 19:21 GMT 19:21 GMT 
 Crystal Palace 0-1 Hoffenheim 
 Some may feel that is harsh but Adam Wharton challenged for the ball and ran the risk of a yellow card.
 So many silly fouls from this Palace side and they are down to 10 and a goal down.
 24 71 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 RED CARD - WHARTON published at 19:20 GMT 19:20 GMT 
 Crystal Palace 0-1 Hoffenheim 
 Well we said Palace were living dangerously and they have been punished!
 Adam Wharton jumps and has his arm over Wouter Burger and that is a second yellow for the Palace midfielder.
 Image source, Getty Images 
 64 189 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 19:19 GMT 19:19 GMT 
 Sparta Prague 1-1 Bournemouth 
 The ball lands to Bournemouth forward Alvaro Rodriguez in the box. He takes a touch and has a shot blocked. They haven't had all that many clear-cut chances today.
 18 6 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 get involved Get Involved published at 19:19 GMT 19:19 GMT 
 Click 'Get Involved' on this page to have your say 
 I know Glasner had a couple of bad spells whilst he was in charge of Palace, but despite having a squad that is deeper and (overall) better than what OG had (apart from Guehi), Sage just cannot get it to click. Think his appointment was bold, but it just hasn't worked.
 Jon 
 Image source, Getty Images
